lineage.description: IPC acute food insecurity phase classifications were collected by FEWS NET field enumerators on a regular schedule and assigned to sub-national geographic units in Zimbabwe. Data were compiled for near-term projection scenarios at four time points in 2014 (January, April, July, October) and distributed as vector geographic files (GeoJSON/KML). The dataset represents modeled food insecurity severity outcomes used to inform humanitarian response planning.
